_comment: Single source of truth for the pre-compiled (.co) kernel families.
READ BY BOTH: opus_gemm_common.py (builds the kid table -> JIT codegen) and
gen_co/build_co.py (builds the .co). Adding a variant is an edit HERE only.
Per-entry fields:
kid            explicit, not positional -- reordering this list must not renumber.
kid is local to the a16w16/gfx1250/CU namespace.
tag            kernel_tag; selects the codegen emit branch and the traits/kargs names.
block_size     threads per workgroup. MUST equal launch_bounds[0].
tile           [B_M, B_N, B_K].
num_slots      LDS prefetch ring depth P: compute/wl use 3; wlr uses 4.
cluster        [cluster_wg_m, cluster_wg_n] -> __cluster_dims__(m, n, 1).
launch_bounds  [maxThreadsPerBlock, minWavesPerEU] -> __launch_bounds__.
num_vgpr       amdgpu_num_vgpr(N) on the entry point; 0 omits the attribute.
dtypes         a/b/c/acc. c is the launcher's only output_dtype.
device_flags   extra device-pass flags for THIS entry (no global default).
variant        optional name suffix, for two entries that differ only in
device_flags -- without it they would collide on one symbol.
num_vgpr, launch_bounds[1] and cluster all appear in the generated symbol name
(..._c{m}x{n}_p{slots}_v{vgpr}w{waves}[_{variant}]), which is simultaneously the
.co filename, the .co's extern "C" symbol and the host launcher symbol.
